notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Developer [b]Friends of Safety[/b] and publisher [b]DANGEN Entertainment[/b] are excited to announce that the first public demo of [i]Kingdom of Night[/i] is now live on Steam as of [b]7:00 AM Pacific Time, September 23, 2025.[/b]
[/p][p]The demo offers players a [b]full vertical slice of the game[/b], delivering an authentic taste of the action-RPG’s mix of [b]coming-of-age drama, cosmic horror, and 1980s nostalgia[/b]. With an [b]average completion time of around 1.5 hours[/b], the demo gives fans freedom to explore, experiment, and soak in the dark streets of Miami, Arizona.[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1695580/Kingdom_of_Night_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Here’s what players can expect in the demo:[/p][list][*][p]A complete slice of [i]Kingdom of Night[/i], straight from the full game.[/p][/*][*][p]Five classes to experiment with: [b]Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, [/b]or[b] Sorcerer.[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]A cast of iconic characters who will play key roles later in the story.[/p][/*][*][p]Freedom to roam the streets of Miami at their own pace, with save slots included (though demo saves will not carry over into the full release).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/035786c9193204321542137786a913d54c0df37c.gif"][/img][/p][p]The demo drops players right into the demon-infested streets of Miami to see what makes [i]Kingdom of Night[/i] a ride worth remembering.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/8fc9f6f58db3217e5e957f4ac20aae4860cb5509.gif"][/img][/p][p]The full release of [i]Kingdom of Night[/i] on PC is planned for Q4 2025. Please stay tuned for an exact date announcement. Console versions to be announced at a later date.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/8be5d027ac849b14c146bee174d5d3553dede6fa.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/a6788bc4012e2caa9e8bd31ddfface600b324ea2.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/d5fbec825cd3b07e28f1e40bf4b518fe6ed974b0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Check out the latest trailer and wishlist to stay up to date with Kingdom of Night![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2sfiVgMjZDA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Trailer Revealed, Demo Coming September 23rd!
notes.notes: [p]In case you missed it, we have [b]big news[/b] for Kingdom of Night followers![/p][p][/p][p]The first [b]public demo[/b] of Kingdom of Night will be released on Steam on [b]September 23rd[/b], less than two weeks away! notes.title: The Road to Release
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a while since our last update, and we have a lot to share--from an upcoming demo, Steam Next Fest, and a potential release, to next steps and physical fulfillment for our Kickstarter backers from many full moons ago! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/66357558af92615f0c898ce8f5a07ea8d5ae853a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Steam Next Fest[/b][/h2][p]It's that time of year again, and now we're gearing up to share Kingdom of Night with the world in the upcoming Steam Next Fest. In preparation, we have new promo art and have polished up some early gameplay to share in a demo that will launch very soon![/p][p]The demo covers the prologue events of the game all the way up to the first major boss enemy, so there's a lot to go through from beginning to end! [b]Please note[/b]: the demo may be long, but save files will [b]not[/b] carry over into the full version of the game. We strongly recommend playing for as long or as little as you like with that in mind![/p][p][/p][h2][b]So the Game’s Actually Coming Out?[/b][/h2][p]Heck yeah it is! We're finally approaching a tentative release window for Kingdom of Night. While the exact date isn't yet set in stone just yet, we can hint that at a [b]Q4 2025[/b] release date for PC.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Are you a Kickstarter backer looking for more info?[/b][/h2][p]Then be sure to check out our most recent [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/72352007/kingdom-of-night-80s-action-rpg-diablo-meets-earth/posts/4482954"][b]Kickstarter update[/b][/url] for more information on the fulfilment side of things, and if you have any questions, you can reach out to us there or via [url="https://discord.gg/KQ3f2zzzSt"][b]our Discord server[/b][/url][b]![/b]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153050/6558655c072a72d8d2e03ef4570b20fac58ca3ac.png"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: We're Still Alive!
notes.notes:
Hi All, 

Just wanted to say that this project is still being actively developed and we're pretty close to being done.
It's a big game, especially considering the size of the team. 

The script has about 100,000 words in it and it's not necessarily a text focused game. The game testers are really enjoying the feel of the gameplay and with all the different classes, subclasses, and weapons we think the game will have a good amount of replay value!

We're not ready to set a release date, but it's coming! Please stay tuned.

If you'd like to chat with us about the game, feel free to join the Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/SpBEwrkdx4]https://discord.gg/SpBEwrkdx4[/url]

- Black Seven
